name: Kaguya-sama: Love is War
tagline: Two geniuses battle to make the other confess their love first
description: Student council members Kaguya and Miyuki are both in love but too proud to confess, turning their romance into psychological warfare. This romantic comedy became a phenomenon with its clever writing, lovable characters, and hilarious mind games.
features: Movie: The First Kiss That Never Ends
cons: Narrator may be annoying to some
